description: Stamina (packages/core/docs/mechanic-predicates.md §9): can this actor afford this action, what state is their stamina in, and what does it regenerate at. Each kb mirrors packages/core/src/prolog/mechanics/stamina-predicates.ts verbatim. There is no stamina_cost predicate: action/4's fourth argument already IS the energy cost. The threshold NAMES are core's and the percentages are the world's, and both comparisons are integer arithmetic (C * 100 =< M * P) so no float rounding can make two engines disagree about who is winded.

cases.name: affords-an-action-the-actor-has-the-energy-for
kb: winded(A) :- energy(A, C, M), M > 0, stamina_threshold(winded, P), C * 100 =< M * P.
exhausted(A) :- energy(A, C, M), M > 0, stamina_threshold(exhausted, P), C * 100 =< M * P.
can_afford_stamina(A, ActionId) :- action(ActionId, _, _, Cost), energy(A, C, _), C >= Cost.
